title: What I've Done
lyrics:
[00:41.52]In this farewell
[00:44.29]There's no blood
[00:46.32]There's no alibi
[00:49.33]'Cause I've drawn regret
[00:52.26]From the truth
[00:54.29]Of a thousand lies
[00:57.28]So let mercy come
[01:00.84]And wash away
[01:04.99]What I've done
[01:08.73]I'll face myself
[01:11.31]To cross out what I've become
[01:16.83]Erase myself
[01:19.29]And let go of what I've done
[01:24.20]Put to rest
[01:26.25]What you thought of me
[01:29.30]While I've cleaned this slate
[01:32.22]With the hands
[01:34.27]Of uncertainty
[01:37.28]So let mercy come
[01:40.78]And wash away
[01:45.00]What I've done
[01:48.74]I'll face myself
[01:51.26]To cross out what I've become
[01:56.84]Erase myself
[01:59.28]And let go of what I've done
[02:20.37]For what I've done
[02:24.80]I start again
[02:27.41]And whatever pain may come
[02:32.81]Today this ends
[02:35.25]I'm forgiving what I've done
[02:42.73]I'll face myself
[02:45.18]To cross out what I've become
[02:50.77]Erase myself
[02:53.20]And let go of what I've done
[03:02.89]What I've done
[03:09.47]Forgiving what I've done
